title: 50% off Google AI Plus 400GB ($39.99), 2TB ($74.99) & Google AI Pro 5TB ($164.99) for 1 Year @ Google One (Existing Users)
body:
Deal: 50% off Google AI Plus 400GB ($39.99), 2TB ($74.99) & Google AI Pro 5TB ($164.99) for 1 Year @ Google One (Existing Users)

[CDG] good find.. i was planning to upgarde to 2TB, now i can pay extra 14. to get Pro with youtube Premium lite.
[watwatwat] This is the first time I'm hearing about Youtube Premium Lite.
It's interesting.. I pay $204 per year for Youtube Premium, plus $30 per year for 100gb of storage space/Google One.
I could replace both of those for $165/year instead, with this deal, and also get 5TB space instead. But……… I think the idea of having ads when listening to music is a deal breaker for me.
[iceman24what] Terms say you can upgrade to YouTube premium at a discounted rate if you have A.I. plus or higher:
“ …Google AI Plus (2 TB or higher) subscription and allows you to add a YouTube Premium individual plan at a discounted price from the standard monthly list price of YouTube Premium (the 'Add-On Offer').”
[Nomad2233] It’s a lesser rate for premium if you have the AI plan
[joedante] Ah, I was getting higher but that was on an account that didn't have Google One. Switched to my account with it and those prices appeared.
[Edsanwong] I am an oldman, I pay $3/month, for extra srorage wirh kids photos.
I should take this offer shouldnt I?
[ChaseTheSun] if you are already on a plan and have cancelled the plan, the re-subsribe price is at full price and not the discounted price. Is this what is expected? i thought existing subscribers could get the discounted prices when renewing?
[CDG] they will recalculate and extend your subscription, that s what google told me
[ChaseTheSun] I can't see anywhere where it does that. Only button is to Resubscribe at the price of $329.99 for AI PRO 5TB, starting on the next day of my current subscription
[scrimshaw] I am getting a refund for the unused portion of my existing 1 year subscription (Aka Pro-rata refund)
You can check by going into Order History
https://play.google.com/store/account/orderhistory
Then look back at your original transaction for the previous subscription, it'll say Refunded.
[ChaseTheSun] Nope, i dont see any refund when i cancelled, the subscription ends at the same date as previously.
[aqsz200] I got refund too, after switch to annual plan with 50% off
[chukie00] I got the deal and got the refund in less than 5 min.
But I did not cancel mine first. just purchase or upgrade and google refunded automatically.
[Murpha] Guess if you've cancelled auto renew, you can't take advantage of the discount? Asking full price for re-subscribe
[ChaseTheSun] yeah that's what i got too, but not sure if there is a way to get around that
[nickelanddime] Students can get AI Plus for free, and AI Pro for half this price for up to 4 years. All benefits except YT Premium shared with family members.
[nsingh21] How can students get AI Plus for free? Appreciate if you could share and care with the link?
[Splagito] I have an existing 1 year 2tb plan, trying to downgrade to the 400gb $39 plan.
Bit confusing how it will work
[Splagito] Discounted plans only appear for upgrades
Does that mean I need to downgrade first to the lowest tier, then upgrade to the plan I want.
Will I get pro rata refunded for the remainder of time on the higher plan I am at the moment
[flyinglove] same here, don't know how to get the $39.99
[hackups] Same question, I am on PRO plan 5TB annual. I guess I need to downgrade then upgrade? Anyone can share experience?
[Shieldsy85] Just did it just toggle to annual payment it gives you the discount got refund on the reminder of the year about 10 mins later
[hackups] @Shieldsy85: Great 👍 It works!
To make it easier for others:
Switch from annual to monthly
Pay
Switch back from annual to monthly
Pay
Now you get the 50% off.
Be reminded you will loose a few dollars if you do the two switches in one singleday, because the plans overlap.
[xaces] @hackups: im on 400gb monthly payment. I only see 400gb annual 79.99 if I switch. Does that mean I dont have 39.99 offer?
[Xizor] Im currently on a $1.99 Google AI Plus 400GB trial. Needless to say, this offer does not show up.
[SAU] Anyone using Pro for any Ai work? Claude is too expensive for home tinkering..
[Vomo] Yes for home lab tinkering - raspberry Pi. It’s not quite as good as Claude, but good enough. Way cheaper
Edit: sorry I mean “plus” not “pro”
[wt860] Claude produces valuable results where Gemini consistently disappoints for professional work, though Claude can be overly restrictive.
[philsw] extensively.. i've had the pro plan free for the last couple of years due to pixel phones including 12 month trials.
with antigravity i'm able to do a lot of coding stuff. and gemini has improved massively in even just the last few weeks and industry seems to think they've basically caught up after a slower start
[raisinberry777] The new Gemini Neon model is excellent - pretty much the level of Opus 5.5. Gemini currently has a bit less usage in the $20 tier than Claude.
[Clockwerk] I prefer Gemini's way of explaining things than Claude which is sometimes confugins. Gemini's explanations lelped a ton when I was tinkering with my homelab/learning.
Claude is better when you ask it to build something straight out though. Haven't tested out Neon though.
[Blargman2001] I use DeepSeek for home tinkering, token cost is a fraction of the other models, especially in off peak times, and it's good enough for home projects. I also use Openrouter in my IDE and switch between the free models to save cost. Baidu Ernie and Particle-1 have performed ok for me. Context window is 1 million tokens which is super generous. The free models change occasionally. If the free models can't solve the problem I'll switch it over to DeepSeek and it usually works.
[Sage222] im on pro. yeah not as good as claude. though certainly workable. ai.studio is very cool to work with.
[poppingtags] If I'm already subscribed to an annual plan, does the remaining balance get applied towards the new plan?
[KB57] Full payment upfront: You pay the full discounted price for the new 1-year plan immediately, and your new 1-year billing cycle starts today.
Separate pro-rata refund: Rather than applying the remaining balance as a discount at checkout, Google issues a separate pro-rata refund for the unused portion of your old plan
[SAU] Checked my account - Ai pro is $250 per year. Targeted prices?
[SAU] Nah, I think if you are not a pro subscriber, then you have to wait till 27th
[Xizor] I checked my alternate google account that has nothing (just base free) and yeah the offers in there for annual subs are poor. Nothing like this. See what happens on Black Friday. Looks like i might need to change google accounts since my main account is on a $1.99 promo that doesnt expire until 12 Dec.
[vikvance] Yeah, it's $294 per year for me.
All their prices are targeted.
[lufee] I bought an annual subscription last month for 5T; is there any way to take advantage of this and get 100 back?
[TaurusHead] I've seen a lot of questions above, wondering if an AI could help buying an AI subscription 😬
[Gamedeals] This doesn't seem to work for none-AI Google One subs. I can't see the deals.
[bcYield] It says member exclusive. I guess you can join a plan to be eligible?
[id] Have any of you upgraded? I didn't proceed coz it seems like upgrading set the date to today with an expiry of 1 year. Negating my 13 July 2027? or have i got this wrong. I don't want to try as its a PITA trying to get refunds from Google.
[nobby] I upgraded from a plus plan to the pro plan. Had about 4 months remaining on the plus subscription. Start date for the pro plan was set to today, and I got a pro rata refund for the old plan (another user above also mentioned this).
[UnnecessarySpendings] I currently have a Google AI Plus 2TB plan that I paid annually in advance.
What happens if I upgrade to Google AI Pro? Very keen to upgrade with discounted Google Play gift cards. Keeping my fingers crossed for a sale starting next Wednesday.
[ReaperX22] See my comment further down! Pro rata refund but you do pay upfront for the new plan with the refund in tow
[bcYield] My Google One app shows this as a Black Friday offer exclusively for members.
This must be a response to the recent plunge in AI stock market.
People invest heavily in AI to replace their jobs. It only works if only the AI can do the jobs for them. It's too early for that to happen.
[Ayzc] Is there anyway to take advantage of this deal if I'm already on the 400gb plan and want to stay on it?
[FerreroRocher] Change to monthly if on annual or downgrade to lower tier then upgrade back to 400GB.
[HKHansson] Great find got the 5tb plan 50percent off! Thanks op
[Powershopz] Bugger… literally just re-subscribed to the annual plan for $80, 4 days ago.
[FerreroRocher] Downgrade or go monthly then upgrade. You should be getting an instant pro-rata refund anyway.
I just did a similar move.
[lakes_8] Hmm only get this offer for the AI pro plan when I only want the 400gb one
[ReaperX22] Look further down the list and click view more plans. That one is hidden probably on purpose!
[boomersgold] So if I already have a plan and purchase a 1Y subscription, it just extend the existing plan end date by a year?
[FerreroRocher] New plan should start today with 1y expiry and pro-rata refund on old plan.
[Gamedeals] Based in the message on X it seems that this same deal will be also available for none members on Friday
[ReaperX22] Thanks OP. My AI plus 2tb just renewed a month ago. I can confirm you pay up front for the new plan and pro rata refund for the old rather than the difference.
All went through got confirmation etc within 5mins. Basically paid 25 bucks extra for the year for the upgrade. Just gotta ensure you setup reminders to downgrade (or cancel) upon renewal time!
[UnnecessarySpendings] Thanks ReaperX22! I'm in the same position. I guess i will get my refund as Google Play balance because i paid for my AI Plus with GP balance. No matter, I'll just use that to renew next year.
[zacsg1] Any idea what happens if the refund is going to a card that is no longer active? I can't seem to find out what to do… Got $33 coming from my 200gb plan. Thanks
[beOson] Wonder what people use these for? Does the AI part replace ChatGPT / Codex by any chance?
[KB57] Yeah, it's similar to OpenAI and Claude subscriptions but comes with lots of perks like cloud storage, Youtube, google health, google home and a few other stuff
[BargainKnight] Not from plus plan. Happy to be wrong. I am using codex but plan to cancel and try Claude.
From Gemini:
Focuses strictly on consumer productivity and storage—400 GB of storage, Gemini in Gmail/Docs, Deep Research, and NotebookLM—with no developer/coding tool upgrades included.
[Aced21] So if i already cancelled, do I wait for the 27th to be able to renew?
[KB57] I'm on bonus AI Pro 5TB plan which came with my Pixel phone and I have cancelled the subscription. It expires on Feb 2027. Tried to resubscribe, but it gives me the full price. However, in google one home page there is "Switch" button in front of "Save 16% with annual billing ($164.99)"; clicking on it gives me this message:
How it works
Your new plan will start immediately
Any discounts with your current plan will end when you switch
I guess if I continue it will cancel my existing bonus plan immediately (losing about 2.5 months) and charge me for the whole year starting from today. I wish I could make it start from the last day of my existing plan but $165 is a good price for about 9.5 months. particularly because it comes with YouTube premium lite, Google Health premium and google home premium.
[FerreroRocher] Yeah probably won't stack/extend. Think of it as a freebie with your Pixel that you would've paid for anyway (the phone cost). It happens all the time. I got some Chromebook perks but couldn't use it because I already had Pixel inclusions on the same account. I didn't want to keep switching accounts.
[Bruskey] Anyone know what happens if you have YouTube Premium Lite already and then upgrade to the pro version that includes lite? Will my subscription just change to $0 each month or do I need to cancel my current YouTube plan
[FerreroRocher] I am not sure since I don't have Lite but I would suggest cancelling YT plan first. Then getting One with YT included.
[illusion99] You need to cancel your current YouTube plan. You can cancel after you sign up. Youtube will just show you have 2 active plans and you cancel the one you don’t want
[bargain_knight] Can someone please explain the use case ?
[KB57] Additional storage, AI, YouTube premium, Google Health premium, Google Home premium and a few more …
[nickelanddime] Storage is the main benefit for my family, with the others as side bonuses
[Circly] Storage for photos? What else are you using storage for? What happens to your photos of you don't subscribe next year?
With the AI, isn't gemini already free?
[illusion99] Your existing photos stay there even if you are over the limit now but you can’t upload any new ones
[JaxSantiago] Im currently on the 2TB plan, with next recurring payment due in March 2027. On top of this, I'm paying $8.99 per month for Youtube Premium Lite.
So I think it makes sense that I upgrade to 5TB plan at $164.99 as it includes Youtube Premium Lite.
A couple of questions though:
- I'm assuming the new plan takes effect immediately, and the unused portion of my previously plan will either be deducted or refunded?
- Do I need to cancel my existing Youtube Premium Lite plan before upgrading Google One?
[FerreroRocher] Yes previous plan gets pro-rata refund. Not sure about YT. You might as well cancel it if it's included with One.
[FerreroRocher] Good deal thanks OP. Makes sense for 2TB+ and eventually if you use Google Store for 10% back say Pixel 12 next year. Downgrade the plan once you've got the 10% store credit and used it.
[RooBun] For anyone already on the 5TB annual plan ($329.99/yr), here's a workaround that worked for me:
I originally subscribed to the 5TB annual plan on 29 Aug for $329.99.
Switch your current plan to the monthly plan first.
Once switched, the $164.99/yr annual offer should show up—just sign up for it.
Both the monthly charge and the original annual plan get refunded automatically (pro-rata for the annual plan; I got over $250 back). My new subscription now runs until 21 Nov 2027. Pretty sweet deal!
[kaboom mel] I am on 2TB plan. The only option I see is to upgrade to 5TB at 50% off or downgrade.
I tried the switch method above - going to monthly. Didn't see any option to get 2Tb plan at 50% off, just the upgrade option. I then even switched back to annual 2TB and still don't see the option
[SpendLess] Haha wish I scrolled down and read your comment. Just read the above and went monthly and now I'm stuck like you
[ricochet] +1 Worked beautifully ty
Worth noting for me it was just switching back again to annual payment that had the discounted price rather than the annual offer showing up in the list of available plans after changing to monthly.
[trotsky] Another person with YT premium looking to jump to the 5TB Pro plan. If anyone works out the optimal approach is cancel YT first or if it just does it automatically, would be great to hear how you handled it. I am not planning to sign up for a couple more days
[tomwhiteallnight] Currently on the Pro poannsifned up last year with the 50% off, can't seem to final a renewal at the $165pa price.
[sena86] Thanks OP! Initially clicked through to upgrade from 100GB to 400GB for just an extra $10 for the year, but ended up going for the 5TB plan instead. The inclusion of Google Home Premium and YouTube Premium Lite, on top of everything else, made it too good to pass up!
